notes:
Klein used "Echinodermata" (and "Echinodermatum") as a description
of echinoid tests rather than as a taxon, which perhaps contributes
to the question of whether this reprint of Klein's 1734 work establishes
the taxon or not.  All other taxa defined here are unavailable even
with this reprint as Klein did not consistently use binomial nomenclature,
which Leske corrected in his lengthy "addendum", gaining authorship
of the taxa in the process.  However, Leske did not address
the term Echinodermata, leaving it to be revived later by Bruguière.
